fields.title: Columns to clean
fields.description: Select which columns should be cleaned. The strings in these columns will be modified according to the configuration of this node.
fields.choicesNote: варианты появятся, когда к узлу подключена входная таблица

fields.title: Remove accents and diacritics
fields.description: When enabled, all accents and diacritics are removed from letters, leaving only the underlying letter. For example, Å becomes A, ë becomes e and だ becomes た.

fields.title: Remove non-ASCII characters
fields.description: When enabled, all non-ASCII characters are removed from strings.

fields.title: Remove non-printable characters
fields.description: When enabled, all non-printable characters like a tabulator or non-break space are removed from strings.

fields.title: Remove letters
fields.description:
Select whether and what category of letters should be removed from strings.
  • None removes no letters.
  • All removes all letters from a string. This includes letters from any language / script.
  • Uppercase removes all uppercase letters from a string.
  • Lowercase removes all lowercase letters from a string.
Note that this step happens before potentially changing the casing of the string.

fields.title: Remove numbers
fields.description: When enabled, all numbers are removed from strings. This includes e.g. 3, Ⅴ or ₅.

fields.title: Remove punctuation
fields.description: When enabled, all punctuation is removed from strings. This includes e.g. _, ( or !.

fields.title: Remove symbols
fields.description: When enabled, all symbols are removed from strings. This includes e.g. €, = or ♮.

fields.title: Other characters to remove
fields.description: Here, custom characters can be defined that should be removed from strings. The characters are all interpreted literally and case-sensitive. Note that this step happens before potentially changing the casing of the string.

fields.title: Remove all whitespace
fields.description: If enabled, all whitespace is removed. This includes normal space ( ), line breaks (\r\n), tabulators (\t) and all other whitespace.

fields.title: Remove leading whitespace
fields.description: If enabled, leading whitespace is removed, that is, all whitespace from the start of the string to the first non-whitespace character.

fields.title: Remove trailing whitespace
fields.description: If enabled, trailing whitespace is removed, that is, all whitespace from the last non-whitespace character to the end of the string.

fields.title: Remove duplicate whitespace
fields.description: If selected, all occurrences of two or more whitespace characters in a row are replaced by a single standard space.

fields.title: Line breaks
fields.description: Select whether to remove line breaks or replace them with a standard space. If Replace by space is selected, \r\n is replaced by only a single space, not two.

fields.title: Special whitespace
fields.description: Select whether to remove special whitespace or replace it with a standard space. Special whitespace is all whitespace that is not a standard space, \r or \n.

fields.title: Change casing
fields.description:
Define the casing of letters in the output string.
  • None makes no changes to the string.
  • Uppercase converts all letters to uppercase.
  • Capitalize first converts all letters to lowercase, then capitalizes according to the defined settings.
  • Lowercase converts all letters to lowercase.

fields.title: Capitalize after
fields.description:
Define after which characters a character should be capitalized.
  • Whitespace capitalizes letters that follow immediately after a whitespace character
  • Non-Letters capitalizes letters that follow any non-letter character.
  • Custom lets the user decide on a set of characters after which letters should be capitalized

fields.title: Capitalize after characters
fields.description: Here, custom characters can be defined after which characters should be capitalized. The characters are all interpreted literally.

fields.title: Capitalize character at the start of the string
fields.description: If enabled, a letter at the start of the string is always capitalized.

fields.title: Pad
fields.description:
Define whether to pad a string if it doesn't have a certain minimum length.
  • None makes no change to the string.
  • Start adds a fill character to the start of the string.
  • End adds a fill character to the end of the string.

fields.title: Minimum string length
fields.description: Define the minimum string length. If a string is shorter than this value, a pad will be added to make the string length equal to it.

fields.title: Fill character
fields.description: Define the fill character that is used to pad the string.

fields.title: Output columns
fields.description: Define whether to clean the strings in-place (i.e. replace the existing values) or append (a) new column(s).

fields.title: Output column suffix
fields.description: Define a suffix that is appended to the column names of the input table.
